extensionDescription.message: Postulo for Thunderbird: job postings from your mail, sent to your own Postulo. A skeleton for now: it connects and shows the message on screen, and does not capture yet.
extensionDescription.description: The extension's description, in Thunderbird's list of add-ons.

tokenHintScopes.message: Made under $PATH$ in Postulo. This extension can use two scopes: $CAPTURES$, to capture a posting, and $BIND$, to file a message into a listing's history. Tick only the ones you want it to use, and nothing else.
tokenHintScopes.description: PATH is where tokens are made in Postulo (tokenPath), in italics; CAPTURES and BIND are the names of two scopes, captures and listings:bind, in code type: keep them as they are.

tokenStored.message: The token is kept unencrypted in this Thunderbird profile. Thunderbird's primary password does not protect it, and anyone who can read the profile folder can use it until you revoke it under $PATH$ in Postulo.
tokenStored.description: PATH is where tokens are made in Postulo (tokenPath), in italics.

saved.message: Saved. This Thunderbird is connected to $HOST$.
saved.description: HOST is the host name of the person's Postulo.

notConnected.message: Not connected to a Postulo yet.
notConnected.description: At the top of the popup while no address and token are set; followed by a Set it up button.

messageHeading.description: Heading over the subject and sender of the message Thunderbird is showing.

noMessage.message: No message is on screen. Open one, then open this again.
noMessage.description: In place of the subject, when Thunderbird shows no message.

messageFrom.description: SENDER is the name or the address the message came from.

noSubject.description: Shown for a message that has no subject.

notBuiltYet.message: Capturing is not built yet. This is the skeleton of the extension: it connects to your Postulo and reads the message on screen.
notBuiltYet.description: Under the capture button, which does nothing yet.

instanceLabel.description: Label of the field for the address of the person's Postulo.

instanceHint.message: The address you open it at. https, unless it runs on this machine.

tokenLabel.description: Label of the field for the token.

tokenPath.description: Where tokens are made in Postulo, in Postulo's own words for both.

test.description: Button that checks the address and the token.

asking.message: Asking Postulo who this token is…
asking.description: Status while the token is checked.

addressRefused.message: Permission to reach that address was refused.

tokenMissing.message: Paste the token Postulo showed you.

tokenIs.description: NAME is the token's name; OWNER the account's email address.

tokenIsScoped.description: As tokenIs; SCOPES lists what the token may do, such as captures, read.

tokenNeither.message: It holds neither the $CAPTURES$ scope nor the $BIND$ scope, so this extension can do nothing with it.
tokenNeither.description: CAPTURES and BIND are the names of two scopes, captures and listings:bind: keep them as they are.

tokenTooWide.message: This token can do more than this extension needs ($EXTRA$). It is kept unencrypted in this profile: make one with only the scopes named above, and revoke this one.
tokenTooWide.description: EXTRA lists the scopes the token holds besides the two the extension uses, such as read, write.

savedNoPermission.message: Saved, but Thunderbird refused permission to reach it; allow it in the add-on's permissions.
savedNoPermission.description: After Save, when Thunderbird did not grant permission to reach the address.

enterAddress.message: Enter the address of your Postulo.

notAnAddress.message: That does not look like a web address.
notAnAddress.description: What was typed is not an address.

httpsOnly.message: Use https for anything that is not on your own machine: the token travels with every request.
httpsOnly.description: An http address somewhere other than this machine.

tokenRefused.message: Postulo does not accept this token. Check it under $PATH$.

notAllowed.message: This token is not allowed to capture.

tooMany.message: Too many captures in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.

answered.description: STATUS is an HTTP status code, such as 500.

settings.description: The gear that opens the extension's settings. Postulo's own word for its Settings.

forgetToken.description: A button in the settings: removes the token from this Thunderbird profile.

tokenForgotten.message: The token is forgotten: it is no longer kept in this Thunderbird profile. It still works until you revoke it under $PATH$ in Postulo.
tokenForgotten.description: PATH is where tokens are made in Postulo (tokenPath).

noCredentialsInAddress.message: Leave the user name and password out of the address: it would never connect, and the password would be shown in the popup.
noCredentialsInAddress.description: The typed address holds a user name or password, as in https://user:secret@host.

notPostulo.message: That address answered, but not as Postulo. Check the address, and any sign-in page in front of it.
notPostulo.description: The instance answered successfully with something that is not Postulo's JSON.

storageFull.message: Thunderbird's storage for Postulo is full. Try again after removing some data, or restart Thunderbird.
storageFull.description: Shown when saving is refused because the storage quota is used up.
